nieuw.titel: Consider Lore Familiar for an Illusion control caster
nieuw.tekst: He thinks an Illusion caster would benefit from Lore Familiar when the plan depends on Miasmic Mirage or Crystal Column. Those are the spells he wants to disrupt the opponent's dangerous offensive pieces.
nieuw.waarom: He wants those control spells almost every time, while Glittering Robe is available as his fallback.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: Without Lore Familiar, he acknowledges the risk of having to roll for the desired spells.

nieuw.titel: Use Kiknik's ambushing Wolf Riders to capture objectives
nieuw.tekst: Use Kiknik Toofsnatcha with ambushing Goblin Wolf Riders as a mobile scoring unit. He particularly likes them for entering vacant space and capturing baggage trains or other objectives.
nieuw.waarom: He says Kiknik grants a Wolf Rider unit free Ambush even in a Grand Army and makes its arrival more reliable on a three-plus.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He describes bringing them on after units have left the deployment zone, then using their nine-inch Reserve Move to contact the baggage train despite being unable to charge that turn.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He notes that rolling a one or two on the first ambush roll can still delay their arrival.

bronnen.citaat: And I really believe in ambushing, especially for objective capturing.

extraCitaten.citaat: They just get to move straight into base contact with the baggage train.

nieuw.titel: Include Fanatics as essential offensive pieces
nieuw.tekst: He considers Fanatics essential to winning with Orcs and Goblins and thinks three are not enough.
nieuw.waarom: In his view, Fanatics provide strong offence that the opponent cannot ignore.

bronnen.citaat: essentially you cannot win games I think without fanatics as orcs and goblins.

nieuw.titel: Combine Netters and Glittering Robe on Night Goblins
nieuw.tekst: He recommends Netters on Night Goblins and combining them with Glittering Robe to make the unit harder to hit and wound.
nieuw.waarom: He argues that moving enemy hit and wound rolls from twos to threes gives the opponent substantially more chances to fail.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He says Netters make charging Strength 5 Empire Knights wound the Night Goblins on threes rather than twos.

bronnen.citaat: They also have netas which I do believe in.

nieuw.titel: Consider ignoring a lone Sky Lantern
nieuw.tekst: In this matchup, he plans to ignore the lone Sky Lantern rather than spend his Doom Diver shots trying to kill it. He wants to deal with the other offensive threats instead.
nieuw.waarom: He expects the Lantern to be difficult to catch and thinks removing its ten wounds would consume too much of the game.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He would still take an opportunity to attack it with a Mangler Squig. He says multiple Lanterns are much harder to ignore.

bronnen.citaat: that's why my plan here is just to kind of ignore the lantern.

nieuw.titel: Get infantry into combat to escape Cathayan bombardment
nieuw.tekst: In this Cathay matchup, try to get the Black Orcs and Night Goblins into infantry combats early. He uses engagement as the way to stop their exposure to the Lantern's bombs and the artillery.
nieuw.waarom: He says those attacks cannot target his infantry once it is in combat, so the opponent does not have the entire game to bombard it.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He warns that an opening volley before he can engage could destroy either infantry unit.

nieuw.titel: Reduce or displace Jade Warriors to deny objective points
nieuw.tekst: In this scenario, reduce Jade Warrior units to nine models or push them off objectives and capture those objectives yourself. Do not ignore them merely because they do little damage.
nieuw.waarom: He warns that the three units can win the game through objective bonuses even while the dangerous units fight elsewhere.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He plans to send three Fanatics through a Jade Warrior unit, hoping to reduce it to Unit Strength 9 so it can no longer score an objective.

unit strength nine, which means they can't score an objective.

nieuw.tekst: He does not expect his Warboss on Wyvern to kill the Shugengan Lord alone. He wants to soften the Lord with Doom Divers or charge alongside a Mangler Squig to inflict impact hits before the likely challenge.
nieuw.waarom: He wants enough early damage to let the Wyvern finish the Lord before its Strength 10 attacks.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He describes a Mangler inflicting two impact-hit wounds on the charge, potentially allowing the Wyvern to finish the Lord.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He thinks the Wyvern's stats favour it without Spectral Doppelganger, but that spell can swing the fight against him.

nieuw.titel: Use Doom Divers to reduce Cathay's opening artillery volley
nieuw.tekst: If going first, aim Doom Divers at the Cathayan artillery to remove pieces before their opening barrage. He sees killing one or two of the four war machines immediately as a major improvement to his chances.
nieuw.waarom: He says a Doom Diver can destroy an artillery piece with one shot, and removing one of the four cuts the initial artillery threat by a quarter.

nieuw.titel: Bring Wolf Riders on where artillery obstructs its own fire
nieuw.tekst: Bring the ambushing Wolf Riders on where Cathayan artillery pieces block one another's line of sight. He also looks for a position inside the Fire Rain Rocket Battery's minimum range.
nieuw.waarom: He hopes this positioning will leave only one artillery piece able to shoot the unit.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says to stay outside the cannon's short-range attack, which would annihilate the Wolf Riders.

bronnen.citaat: the artillery blocks their own line of sight.
